details:
Version: 2020.1.1
Description of the bug: Upon initialization of a home world, I've lately been getting stuck in a type of void. The world looks only partially loaded, with odd lighting and missing textures. Movement is not possible in this state. I can look over to another part of the world and see the tips shown in the loading screen. The loading music can also be heard. It's like I joined the world before it finished initializing. A complete restart is necessary to mitigate this, though I have experienced it happen again after restart. I fail to see a pattern to the intermittent behavior.
Steps to reproduce (how did you encounter the bug?): I'm really not sure. The only times I've experienced it was after starting the game and joining my home world:
https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_24c89b13-333a-43b2-96c4-a67914aaba91
It's possible the problem is linked to this specific world.
Any extra files? (output logs, screenshots):
I've attached some screenshots of the issue. First one is the normal world. The two following were taken during the glitch. I've placed a red box around the tips, usually seen on the loading page.
title: Incomplete World Initialization
